verses.1: And in all this, we are faithful witnesses and writers. And on the seals of our priests, they write down what they say.
verses.2: And upon the tablets were inscribed Nekhmeiah, the son of Chachalyah, and Tzidkiyeh.
verses.6: A curse from those who are evil.
verses.9: Maa’azya Bilgai Shma’ya – these are the priests.
verses.10: And Helvyim and Yeshua, son of Azaniah, were among the descendants of Hanadad Kedemiel.
verses.11: And their names were Shvaniyah Hodia, Klitai Plaia, and Hanan.
verses.15: The leaders of the people were Pharaohsh, Pachhat, Moab, Eilam, and Zatu.
verses.17: Adoniyah in the land of giants.
verses.25: The liar will be punished again.
verses.26: Mercy is the result of actions.
verses.29: And the rest of the people: the priests, the Levites, the singers, the ministers, and all those who were separated from the other nations to serve God’s laws. Their sons and daughters all know this.
verses.30: They hold onto their great responsibilities and go forth with determination to carry out the commands of God, which were given to Moses as the servant of God. They must keep these commands, laws, and regulations in accordance with the will of our Lord.
verses.31: And since we did not give our daughters to the nations of the earth, nor take their daughters as our own.
verses.32: And the people of the land who bring their offerings and all kinds of goods on the day of Sabbath, they shall not be taken from them on Sabbath or in a holy day. They will also be exempt from paying taxes for the seventh year.
verses.33: And we were commanded to give two shekels each year as offerings to our God.
verses.34: For the sacrifices that are offered as offerings and as a constant nourishment, and for those who constantly go to the holy places every Sabbath. Also, for all sins that are committed against Israel, and for all the work done in our houses of worship.
verses.35: And the priests rushed upon the branches of the trees, and the people rushed forward to bring things into our house, into our ancestors’ house. This is what is written in the Torah.
verses.36: And to bring the carcasses of our land’s animals, and the carcasses of all fruits and trees, from one year to another, into the house of Jehovah.
verses.37: And we shall bring the offerings of our children and of our animals, as it is written in the Torah. We shall also bring the offerings from our flocks and herds, so that they may be given to the priests who serve in our Temple.
verses.38: And they shall take away the roots of our crops and all the fruits of the trees we grow. They will also take away everything that belongs to our land for the use of the people. And those people will be the ones who own all the land where we work.
verses.39: And the priest, Bezalel, would be with the Levites during those ten days. During those ten days, the Levites would bring the offerings to our God’s temple, to the altars in the house of the Lord.
verses.40: For the offerings will be brought to the priests by the sons of Israel and by the sons of Levi. They will bring along with them the offerings of grain, wine, and other sacred offerings. And there, in that place, will be all the sacred objects, as well as the priests who serve there. We will not leave our God’s house behind.
